column1: # Queryopsy history plan used by publish.ps1 / publish.sh on a brand-new repository.
# One line per pull request, TAB separated: branch, labels (comma separated, "-" for none), title, paths (space separated), summary.
# Lines starting with "main" are committed straight to main before the first pull request.

column3: chore: project skeleton, licence and repository settings
column5: Start of Queryopsy: MIT licence, README, version file, pytest config and dev requirements.

column3: chore(vendor): bundle Pyodide 0.29.5, the sqlite3 wheel and OFL fonts locally
column5: Ships CPython 3.13 + SQLite (Pyodide 0.29.5, MPL-2.0) and the Courier Prime, Special Elite and JetBrains Mono fonts inside the repo so the app never touches a CDN. tools/vendor.py re-downloads and checksum-verifies every file.

column3: feat(engine): sandboxed SQLite runner with statement splitting, timeout and friendly errors
column5: In-memory SQLite loaded with Connection.deserialize, a 4 second progress-handler guard against runaway queries, quote-aware statement splitting and plain-English explanations (with did-you-mean) for common SQL errors.

column3: feat(engine): hash-based answer validator with row and column diff feedback
column5: Canonicalises result sets (NULLs, 2 dp rounding, numeric strings, whitespace), compares salted SHA-256 fingerprints so answers are never shipped in plain text, and reports columns, row counts, matching rows and order-only mistakes.

column3: feat(editor): SQL tokenizer, syntax highlighting and context-aware autocomplete
column5: A small SQL tokenizer used for highlighting and for autocomplete that understands tables, aliases and columns at the cursor position, plus engine tests.

column3: feat(pipeline): CSV/XLSX ingestion with header auto-detection, cleaning and ER diagrams
column4: pipeline/__init__.py pipeline/base.py pipeline/readers.py pipeline/clean.py pipeline/erd.py pipeline/build.py pipeline/datasets/__init__.py pipeline/datasets/_names.py data/raw/README.md docs/DATA-INPUTS.md tests/test_pipeline.py
column5: Reads CSV (encoding fallback, delimiter sniffing) and XLSX with the standard library, matches headers to known aliases, cleans Indian number formats, messy dates and mojibake, renders clickable SVG ER diagrams and builds the SQLite case files.

column3: feat(cases): Orientation and Funding Forensics (8 levels)
column5: Startup funding rounds and investors: future-dated filings, city spelling variants, duplicate rounds, the biggest cheque of each year (window functions) and the most active investors. Also powers the 3-level orientation case.

column3: feat(cases): Dark Store Delivery Audit (4 levels)
column5: Quick-commerce orders, platform promises and rider payouts: impossible delivery speeds, late-delivery rates, duplicate payouts and the fastest app in every city.
Grocery catalogue checks: ghost stock, discount maths that does not add up, stock value per aisle and the same product listed at two prices.
UPI transactions and banks: the riskiest hour, leakiest bank corridors, planted midnight whales and public vs private bank failure rates.
HR and payroll: salaries paid after an exit date, one bank account on two employees, double payslips and a RANK() league table of leaks by department.

column3: feat(cases): compile 6 cases / 24 levels with hashed answers and planted-anomaly log
column4: data/cases.json data/planted.json docs/PLANTED.md tests/conftest.py tests/test_cases.py tests/fixtures/solutions.json
column5: The compiled catalogue the app loads (briefs, hints, answer fingerprints), the documented list of planted anomalies, and tests proving every official solution and final hint passes while wrong answers fail.

column3: feat(ui): case-file design system with Dossier and Crime Lab themes
column4: src/ui/casefile.css src/ui/ios.css src/ui/theme_toggle.py src/ui/dom.py src/ui/store.py assets tools/contrast_check.py tests/test_theme.py
column5: Manila dossier and night crime-lab themes plus the native-style app-mode stylesheet (iOS-like bars, sheets and switches), with typewriter type, stamps, evidence tags and red string, remembered per device, responsive breakpoints, reduced-motion support, local progress storage and the logo and icons.

column3: feat(ui): case workspace, editor, schema explorer, ER diagram, hints and onboarding
column4: src/ui/__init__.py src/ui/app.py src/ui/appmode.py src/ui/editor.py src/main.py src/boot.js index.html manifest.webmanifest sw.js tools/build_site.py tools/serve.py
column5: The Python app running in Pyodide: routing, dossier and level stepper, highlighted editor with autocomplete, clickable schema and ER diagram, diff verdicts, progressive hints, history, shortcuts, the native-style app mode for phones and the Android app (large-title screens, tab bar, bottom sheets, swipe back), the prerendered home page, the PWA service worker and a dev server.

column3: feat(reports): on-device audit certificate as PNG and PDF
column5: Draws the completion certificate on a canvas from Python and exports PNG or a dependency-free A4 PDF, with a deterministic certificate ID.

column3: test(e2e): Playwright suite solving every level in the browser, plus screenshots
column5: Boots the real app, solves all 24 levels, checks diff feedback, errors, autocomplete, themes, certificates, onboarding, mobile layout and offline mode, failing on any console error or outside request.

column3: feat(android): offline WebView app with zero permissions
column5: Locked-down WebView serving the bundled site from https://appassets.androidplatform.net, no INTERNET permission, system file picker for certificates, adaptive icons, a Gradle-free build script and an APK payload smoke test.

column3: ci: CI, Pages, Release and CodeQL workflows, templates and one-command publishing
column5: Unit and Playwright CI, GitHub Pages deployment, release bundles on tags, CodeQL, Dependabot, issue and PR templates, labels, CODEOWNERS and the publish scripts.

column3: docs: changelog, contributing guide, code of conduct, security policy and dataset credits
column4: CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md SECURITY.md docs/DATASETS.md docs/release-notes
column5: Community and project documentation, dataset licences and credits, and the release notes for every version.
